subject: Heartbox operator standard operating procedure (palette, ports, deploy, release)
opening: Bottom line: Heartbox is a single canonical dark palette with many application ports. Operators edit palette/heartbox.json, regenerate ports, deploy the product site on Cloudflare Pages (heartbox.f00.sh), and ship SemVer releases with the full documentation pack.

sections.heading: 1. Purpose
sections.body: This memorandum is the living operator handbook for Heartbox. It states how to change colors, regenerate ports, deploy the site, and ship a versioned release.

sections.heading: 2. Scope
sections.body: This SOP covers product operations for Heartbox. It does not replace the README, man page, or the live site at https://heartbox.f00.sh.
items: release ship flow and docs pack

steps.text: All ports derive from palette/heartbox.json. Do not invent one-off hex values.
Silver (#B8C0C8) is required on cursor, chrome, and punctuation tokens.
Warm hospital-night blacks; poppy red is the hero accent; cream foreground — not pure white.
Cloudflare Pages is the delivery plane for the public site. GitHub is source and release history only.
Every SemVer release updates CHANGELOG, file_id.diz, README, man, SOP PDF, and this-version release memo PDF.

sections.heading: 5. Day-to-day operator flow
sections.body: Use this path for palette changes and port quality checks.

steps.text: Clone github.com/f00-sh/heartbox and enter the repository root.
Edit palette/heartbox.json only when changing colors.
Run: python3 scripts/generate-themes.py
Review git diff under palette/ and themes/. Confirm silver still appears on cursor tokens.
If tokens changed, update site/app.js COLORS and site/styles.css :root to match.
Open site/index.html locally and confirm swatches and poppy field render.

figure.title: Heartbox canonical palette
figure.caption: Token grid used across all ports. Poppy red is the hero accent; silver is the cool metal jacket token.

steps.text: Push site/** to main (GitHub Actions pages.yml deploys with CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN).
Or manual: npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=f00-heartbox --branch=main
Verify https://f00-heartbox.pages.dev and https://heartbox.f00.sh return HTTP 200.
DNS: CNAME heartbox.f00.sh → f00-heartbox.pages.dev (proxied). Custom domain attached on Pages project f00-heartbox.
Bump version in palette/heartbox.json, CHANGELOG.md, file_id.diz, README, SOP version.
Regenerate ports. Update man page if tokens or install paths changed.
Render NASA SOP PDF and this-version NASA release memo PDF via memo-pdf skill.
Tag vX.Y.Z, create GitHub Release, attach install.sh, file_id.diz, SOP PDF, memo PDF.
Update f00 hub product card on first ship or when copy/links change.

sections.heading: 8. Failure responses
items: Generator fails: fix JSON syntax in palette/heartbox.json, re-run.
Pages deploy 401: refresh CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and account id secrets.
Custom domain 522: wait for certificate validation; confirm CNAME proxied to f00-heartbox.pages.dev.
Port contrast poor: adjust token in palette only, regenerate all ports together.
